neighbours.label: the phrase naming a solved protein or crystal structure, after a method such as X-ray or cryo-EM: 'revealed the structure of', 'its structure at 2 Å resolution'
fire: Cryo-EM revealed the structure of the spike protein.
X-ray crystallography revealed the structure of the enzyme.
They solved the structure of the ribosome in 2000.
We report the crystal structure of the human receptor at high resolution.
Researchers solved its structure at 2.1 Å resolution.
NMR revealed the structure of the toxin.
The team determined its structure at 3 Å resolution.
Diffraction data revealed the structure of DNA.
quiet: Old photos revealed the structure of the barn.
Company records revealed the structure of the firm.
They sold the house near the ribosome lab in 2000.
We report the annual budget of the school at high season.
Researchers took its photo at sunset.
NMR cost the lab a lot of money.
The team bought its tickets at the door.
Census data revealed the age of the town.

notes: A new round: the sweep label 'solved protein structure' had AUROC 1.000 but median 0.186. The stronger readings there came after a method ('Cryo-EM revealed', 0.59, and 'at high resolution', 0.37), so this test keeps those frames.
